verdict: Meta's revenue rose 19% to $40.6B as ad prices climbed 11% and impressions grew 7% — and it kept $15.7B as profit, about 39 cents of every dollar, even as Reality Labs lost another $4.4B.

follow100Note: Advertising alone is $98.27 of every $100 Meta takes in. The rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

takeaways.title: Ads did the lifting
takeaways.text: Advertising revenue grew 19% to $39.9B — 98 cents of every dollar Meta made — helped by 7% more ad views and an 11% higher average price per ad.

takeaways.title: Reality Labs still burns cash
takeaways.text: Reality Labs lost $4.4B in the quarter on just $270M of revenue, and Meta said its losses would grow meaningfully in 2024 as it keeps building headsets and glasses.

takeaways.title: Cash generation stayed enormous
takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $15.5B even after $9.2B of capital spending, and Meta raised its full-year capex outlook to $38–40B, mostly for AI computing.
